hotels.title: São Paulo City Break with Outdoor Pool, Sauna & Brazilian-Italian Fusion Restaurant
hotels.description: Experience the vibrant pulse of São Paulo’s Vila Olímpia district, where designer boutiques, contemporary art galleries and the lush Parque do Povo green space beckon. Savour Italian favourites with a Brazilian touch at the onsite La Forchetta restaurant or head out to discover the nearby foodie and bar scene. Return to refined comfort with a swim and a spot of sun by the sprawling outdoor pool, or enjoy a session in the fully-equipped fitness centre. Sip craft cocktails at the stylish onsite bar before retreating to the modern comforts of your stylish aprtment.
